# U.S. Department of the Interior

> > The U.S. Department of the Interior manages federal lands, natural resources, tribal affairs, and insular territories through bureaus including the National Park Service, Bureau of Land Management, Bureau of Indian Affairs, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, and Bureau of Reclamation.

DOI oversees conservation, energy development, wildland fire management, and trust responsibilities to Native American tribes and U.S. territories. The department administers the Great American Outdoors Act (GAOA) for infrastructure investment and maintains comprehensive policy guidance through its Departmental Manual system.

## Key Topics

- Bureau of Land Management (BLM)
- National Park Service (NPS)
- Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA)
- U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS)
- Bureau of Reclamation
- Great American Outdoors Act (GAOA)
- Tribal consultation and trust responsibilities
- Wildland fire management
- Deferred maintenance and legacy restoration
- Insular affairs and U.S. territories
- Appraisal and valuation services (AVSO)
- Departmental Manual policies
- Climate change science
- Human capital and diversity
- Occupational safety and health

## Bureaus & Core Operations

- [Bureaus & Offices](https://www.doi.gov/bureaus): Directory of DOI bureaus including BIA, BLM, and other agencies
- [Tribal Consultation](https://www.doi.gov/priorities/tribal-consultation): DOI tribal consultation policy and trust responsibilities framework
- [Services Provided by the Office of Wildland Fire](https://www.doi.gov/wildlandfire/services-provided-office-wildland-fire): Office of Wildland Fire services supporting fire management operations
- [Deputy Assistant Secretary - Human Capital and Diversity](https://www.doi.gov/pmb/hcd): Human Capital & Diversity office overseeing HR and civil rights programs
- [About Us - Appraisal and Valuation Services Office](https://www.doi.gov/valuationservices/about-us): AVSO appraisal services for federal lands and tribal trust property

## Great American Outdoors Act (GAOA)

- [About GAOA](https://www.doi.gov/about-gaoa): Great American Outdoors Act mission, funding, and operations overview
- [Deferred Maintenance & Repair](https://www.doi.gov/deferred-maintenance-and-repair): GAOA deferred maintenance programs and asset management guidance

## Departmental Manual & Policy Guidance

- [512 DM 3 - Departmental Responsibilities for Protecting/Accommodating Access to Indian Sacred Sites](https://www.doi.gov/document-library/departmental-manual/512-dm-3-departmental-responsibilities-protectingaccommodating): Departmental Manual policy on Indian sacred sites access and protection
- [526 DM 1 - Applying Climate Change Science](https://www.doi.gov/document-library/departmental-manual/526-dm-1-applying-climate-change-science-transmittal-sheet): Climate change science application policy transmittal sheet
- [485 DM 7-10 - Accident/Incident Reporting](https://www.doi.gov/document-library/departmental-manual/485-dm-7-10-transmittal-sheet-accidentincident-reporting-2): Accident/incident reporting and occupational safety procedures manual
- [142 DM 7 - Assistant Director - International Affairs](https://www.doi.gov/document-library/departmental-manual/142-dm-7-assistant-director-international-affairs): USFWS Assistant Director for International Affairs organizational manual
